title: Landing Page
concept: A single-offer landing page for Mise, a fictional plate-costing tool for independent restaurants: one primary CTA (30-day free trial), a hero where a fish invoice arrives and re-costs a dish live, then problem → benefits → how it works → case study → FAQ → risk-reversal final CTA.
notes: Layout A (classic hero + sections). Indexed evergreen page: title/meta set and FAQ rendered as plain Q/A with FAQPage JSON-LD. Hero card has a 'Replay invoice' button; reduced motion shows the final state without tweening.
